newsitem.title: USA: Lifeway Foods in manufacturing pact.
newsitem.headline: Lifeway Foods in manufacturing pact.

text.p: Lifeway Foods Inc said Tuesday said it entered an exclusive agreement to make and market five kinds of drinkable yogurt for Quay Corp, which produces and distributes dairy products for the Hispanic market.
Lifeway said the yogurt products will be distributed nationally by Quay under the brand name, Yogurito.

"Results of test markets indicate that this product line could produce sales of $2 million to $3 million for Lifeway and we are discussing with Quay's management the possibility of exporting Yogurito to Mexico," Michael Smolyansky, president, said in a statement.
Lifeway makes a fermented dairy beverage known as kefir and also markets farmer cheese, drinkable yogurts and a vegetable seasoning called Golden Zesta.
